camel_example: aliyun ice GetCategories --region cn-hangzhou --Type default --PageSize 10 --SortBy 'CreationTime:Desc' --PageNo 1 --CateId 33 --version 2020-11-09 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the information about a category and its subcategories
description_zh: 调用GetCategories获取指定的分类信息，及其子分类（即下一级分类）的列表
kebab_example: aliyun ice get-categories --cate-id 33 --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --sort-by CreationTime:Desc --type default --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetCategories

parameters.help_en:
The category ID. You can use one of the following methods to obtain the ID:

Log on to the Intelligent Media Services (IMS) console (https://ims.console.aliyun.com) and choose Media Asset Management > Category Management to view the category ID.

View the value of CateId returned by the AddCategory operation that you called to create a category.

View the value of CateId returned by the GetCategories operation that you called to query a category
parameters.help_zh:
分类ID。可通过以下方式获取：
登录IMS控制台 (https://ims.console.aliyun.com)，选择 媒资管理 > 分类管理查看分类ID。
通过创建分类接口创建分类时，分类ID为返回参数CateId的值。
通过获取分类接口查询分类时，为请求后返回参数CateId的值
parameters.name: cate_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 10 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，最小值为10，最大值为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The sorting rule of results. Valid values:

- CreationTime:Desc (default): The results are sorted in reverse chronological order based on the creation time.

- CreationTime:Asc: The results are sorted in chronological order based on the creation time
parameters.help_zh:
结果排序方式。取值范围：

CreationTime:Desc（默认值）：按创建时间倒序。

CreationTime:Asc：按创建时间升序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The type of the category. Valid values: default and material. A value of default indicates audio, video, and image files. This is the default value. A value of material indicates short video materials
parameters.help_zh:
分类类型。取值：

default（默认值）：音视频/图片分类。

material：短视频素材分类
parameters.name: type

Level.description_en: The level of the category. A value of 0 indicates a level-1 category, a value of 1 indicates a level-2 category, and a value of 2 indicates a level-3 category
